verdict.rationale: The evidence never describes natural-language commands directly. The closest first-party capability is the Bazaar MCP server, which lets an MCP-compatible agent discover payable services through tool calls. The Agentic Wallet also lets a user's agent discover and pay for x402 services, which suggests agent-mediated, conversational use of discovery and payment. Missing for 10: any documented natural-language interface or command flow, NL operation of seller-side setup or facilitator management, an explicit buyer payment workflow driven by NL prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven use.
